decisions.reason: Premium customer support is tightly linked to the firm's core hosting and service model and is relatively cheap to keep open, so despite weaker later visibility its strategic fit still supports continuation.

After several years the software version management tool should have revealed its traction, and if it is not prominent by now the ongoing development effort is better redirected to the core platform and newer growth options.

The data-processing-contract tool is distant from the firm's main business and likely needs continuing legal and product updates, so with limited evidence of payoff its option value now looks too low to justify keeping it.

Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship, core-adjacent offering that fits the firm's stated direction, existing infrastructure, and growing market, so management would strongly favor retaining it.
